name: W9 ensemble roundtable (orchestra Kaggle)
goal: The overriding goal is higher AUROC on UNSEEN accounts; treat any overfitting to training data, validation folds or leaderboard feedback as a defect.
task: Using the ensemble techniques from Lecture 9 (bagging / random forests, boosting — AdaBoost and gradient boosting with the slide-40 overfitting controls — and aggregation by majority vote, simple average or weighted average), propose an ensemble for this competition that improves on the incumbent final model without overfitting. Explain which W9 techniques you use and why (cite slides as W9 sN), how the members differ enough to be near-independent (W9 s14, s20), how each member is regularised, how the aggregation weights are chosen leakage-free, and how it will be validated.
risk_focus: overfitting, leakage, members that are too correlated to help, weights tuned on the scored folds
final_instructions: Finalise the ensemble architecture exactly: members, features, hyperparameters (fixed or tuned only in inner CV), aggregation rule, validation protocol and anti-overfitting measures.
readme_extra: Reference: the incumbent model scored lockbox AUROC 0.99155 (95% CI 0.984-0.997) and development nested-CV AUROC 0.9835 on the same lockbox split. The lockbox has 66 positives, so differences below about 0.01 are within noise. METRICS.json in each package was computed by the operator; lockbox scores were hidden from the competitors.

execute.contract: EXECUTION CONTRACT: the operator runs your script once. DATA_DIR train.csv EXCLUDES the hidden lockbox; DATA_DIR test.csv holds the lockbox IDs. Read os.environ['DATA_DIR']; write ONLY inside os.environ['OUT_DIR']. Baseline modules (clean, features, select_features, models, final_model) are importable after sys.path.insert(0, os.environ['BASELINE_SRC']); clean.py there reads DATA_DIR. Python 3.14, CPU only (8 cores), 25-minute limit; libraries: numpy, pandas 3, scipy, scikit-learn 1.9 (has RandomForest, ExtraTrees, AdaBoost, GradientBoosting, HistGradientBoosting, Bagging, Voting/Stacking), torch 2.13 CPU, pyarrow, threadpoolctl. No installs, network or subprocess. Set seeds. Required outputs in OUT_DIR: results.json {"models": {name: {"cv_auroc": float, "notes": str}}, "best": name, "validation": str}; oof_final.csv (account.id,pred) for EVERY train.csv account; submission.csv (ID,Predicted) for every test.csv ID; diagnostics.json (train vs CV AUROC, fold spread, member correlations, chosen weights).
